why_new_namespace: Earlier G9Q was preregistered in Git but its exact experiment.py/data bytes were not present at the inspected branch and no completed training/release existed. This reconstruction changes data seeds and therefore is a separately registered experiment, not a completion claim for old G9Q.
primary_hypothesis: On identical memory histories, query-conditioned sequence-level contrastive ranking of the correct queried value above another current key value improves free generation and both-correct counterfactual pairs versus positive-NLL-only training with identical candidate scoring compute.
optimizer: restore G8C AdamW state; stage3 LR cosine 0.0002 to 0.00004; betas(.9,.95), weight_decay .01, clip1

objective.query_contrast: mean positive sequence NLL + 0.5*mean softplus(0.5 + nll_positive - nll_counterfactual_answer)
objective.nll_control: mean positive sequence NLL + 0.0*mean counterfactual-answer NLL; negative candidates are still scored in the same tensor/forward pass
objective.sequence_score: length-normalized NLL of F=<integer> plus EOS under the same prompt

data.split_rule: split by query-invariant memory-history canonical group before rendering
data.denied: all available G5S parent and G8C fresh canonical groups; G8C held is never training data

free_generation: prompt strings only; greedy unrestricted byte259; max32 new bytes; EOS required; one terminal F=<integer>; no solver/case/gold input
selection: fixed step600 only; validation and held never select checkpoint or hyperparameters
scope: small memory-addressing mechanism test; NOT a 300-800M model, NOT broad reasoning/code evidence, NOT Qwen parity
next_if_positive: port verified objective into broader generative training and retest fresh reasoning/code before scale
next_if_negative: reject this objective at this scale and test an architectural query-readout/gate separately; do not merely extend updates
